spanish: Y lo darás delante de la parójet que sobre arca del testimonio, delante de la kappóret que sobre el testimonio, que me citaré a ti allá.

findings.issue: Common noun (H6532, definite feminine singular) is left as the untranslated transliteration parójet.
Common noun (H3727, definite feminine singular) is left as the untranslated transliteration kappóret.
Niphal 1cs of H3259 is rendered with reflexive me citaré, which fixes a middle/reflexive reading and uses an uncertain Spanish verb.

notes: Other tokens match: Y lo darás, delante de, que sobre, arca del testimonio, el testimonio, a ti, allá.
